g.text: Confirm that the exact MAX7219 breakout permits the Uno's 5 V supply and logic levels, and that current-setting parts are fitted.

g.desc: Confirm that the exact MAX7219 breakout permits the Uno's 5 V supply and logic levels, and that current-setting parts are fitted.

g.text: ERC and net checks do not validate an unidentified module or display orientation. Physical test pending.

g.desc: ERC and net checks do not validate an unidentified module or display orientation. Physical test pending.

g.text: J1 pins: 1=VCC, 2=CS/LOAD, 3=DIN, 4=CLK, 5=GND. This is a logical module connector, not a particular breakout footprint.

g.desc: J1 pins: 1=VCC, 2=CS/LOAD, 3=DIN, 4=CLK, 5=GND. This is a logical module connector, not a particular breakout footprint.

g.text: Uno wiring: 5 V and GND to the module supply; D10 to CS/LOAD; D11/MOSI to DIN; D13/SCK to CLK. D12/MISO is unused.

g.desc: Uno wiring: 5 V and GND to the module supply; D10 to CS/LOAD; D11/MOSI to DIN; D13/SCK to CLK. D12/MISO is unused.
